cl.x: Provide LANKO 752 Bondit where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01).

LANKO 752 Bondit is a P.V.A. based emulsion for use as a mortar additive, primer and sealer. LANKO 752 Bondit increases the adhesion, flexibility, tensile strength and impact resistance of mortars. Also suitable for bonding timber to timber.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Mixed with water and applied to concrete surfaces for priming, dustproofing and sealing. As an additive to sand/cement for concrete patching applications. As an additive in sand/cement for rendering applications. As an additive in mortars for tiling over concrete, render, blockwork and rendered brickwork surfaces. As a slurry into neat cement for bonding new sand/cement toppings onto concrete surfaces. For bonding timber onto timber.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: Surfaces, must be dry, structurally sound, clean, free of dust,dirt, wax, oil, grease, asphalt, mastic, latex compounds, adhesives, paint, gypsum-based products and other contaminants.
Ensure all release agents are removed from surface of concrete, especially tilt-up slabs.
Painted surfaces should be scabbled to expose at least 80% of the original surface.
Very porous surfaces must be primed with LANKO 752 Bondit as per instructions below.
New concrete must be allowed to cure for six weeks and have a wood float finish.
Steel trowel finished concrete must be acid etched or wire brushed prior to tiling.
Old concrete and rendered surfaces must be thoroughly cleaned prior to tiling.
Newly rendered surfaces must be allowed to cure for at least 7 days.

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Application Information > Consumption
cl.x: Joinery: Approximately 3.5m²/L when used neat, depending upon surface porosity and site conditions. Priming: 6-8m²/L when diluted with water and applied with a brush or roller. Mortar Addition: Approximately 750 mL to 1L of LANKO 752 Bondit with required water to each 20 kg of sand/cement mix.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing > Rendering Mix
s: 1 part LANKO 752 Bondit
4 parts water
3:1 sand/cement mix
tr: Apply with a flat trowel onto the surface to be rendered.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing > Priming and Sealing Mix
s: 1 part LANKO 752 Bondit
3 parts water
tr: Apply with a broom/brush onto the floor or wall.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing > Concrete Patching Mix
s: 1 part LANKO 752 Bondit
4 parts water
3:1 sand/cement mix
tr: Apply with a flat trowel or spatula to patch holes or depressions in concrete or rendered surfaces after priming.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing > Joinery
cl.x: Neat LANKO 752 Bondit can be used to bond timber to timber. Apply with a brush or roller.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application
cl.x: Refer to individual mortar datasheets for details on application techniques.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean up tools and equipment with water while LANKO 752 Bondit is still wet.

s: Do not use LANKO 752 Bondit in temperatures above 40ºC and below 5ºC.
Do not use LANKO 752 Bondit in permanently wet or damp areas such as swimming pools and spas. In these types of installations, use Davco Lanko 751 Lankolatex.
LANKO 752 Bondit is not recommended for the bonding of plastic or rubber.
